post_text:
Hot take: your RAG demo dies the day someone asks "how do you know it's right?"

A golden set of 40 real questions would have caught it. Most teams ship without one — then debug in production.

Build the eval before the agent. It's cheaper than the incident.

sourced_claims.claim: Most teams ship RAG without a golden set

speculative_claims: 40 questions is the right starting size
